post.text:
Check out this amazing combo using Gemma4 + Falcon Perception for video tracking!

1️⃣Give Gemma 4 video frames
2️⃣It describes what it sees
3️⃣Falcon Perception takes those descriptions, segments the objects, and tracks them across the video!

The best part? All running locally! https://t.co/K4LZKE0kxs
